messages:
anya: heads-up: found discrepancy between REST /v1/models/<id>/stream-config and Python SDK. REST honors max_buffer_ms, SDK call seems to no-op on that param.
mike: can you paste minimal curl vs sdk so i can repro?
anya: curl (works):
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/ggml-1/stream-config" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"max_buffer_ms":50,"enable_partial":true}'
```
anya: sdk (returns ok but server kept 200ms):
```
from redwood import Client
c = Client(token=os.getenv("TOKEN"))
resp = c.models.set_stream_config("ggml-1", max_buffer_ms=50, enable_partial=True)
print(resp)
# => {"ok": true} but still using default buffer
```
olga: damn, that extra 200ms kills interactivity for us.
sam: fwiw, saw another mismatch: SDK retry loop ignores Retry-After header on 429 and retries immediately (no backoff).
mike: do you have raw headers for the 429?
sam: captured:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 3
X-Request-Id: rq_12ab34
```
sam: sdk trace shows immediate retry attempts:
```
[retry] attempt=1 reason=429
[retry] attempt=2 reason=429
```
mike: two separate tickets then: (1) stream-config param mapping; (2) Retry-After honoring. i'll open GH and tag eng-runtime + devex.
mike: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/issues/4721 - "SDK stream-config param ignored; retry ignores Retry-After"
dev-bot: github issue created: runtime#4721 by mike
anya: temporary workaround: call REST directly or use client.http.request("POST","/v1/models/ggml-1/stream-config", json=...) and implement manual respect for Retry-After in our client side.
olga: also consider emitting a debug log when sdk gets 200 ok but server reports unchanged config.
sam: i'll add unit tests for parsing Retry-After and for mapping nested stream_config params.
mike: assigning patch to devex/sdks; will prioritize small mapping PR then follow up on retry strategy.
anya: thanks — ping when PR lands. :pray:
